summary: Cowork-team daily document redesign — shared daily folder per agent, two-lane delivery (postman + danger direct), long-horizon recaps. 3-phase migration. 22 agent-father actions across F1-F22.
phase_sequence: Phase 1 (F1-F5): Foundation — no agent flow changes
Phase 2 (F6-F14): Parallel run — agents append to daily folder, existing delivery unchanged
Phase 3 (F15-F22): Full cutover — delta-read, postman cron, CHEF reads daily folder
first_action: F1: Create directory structure (docs/daily/, docs/outbox/*, docs/recaps/*) and update .gitignore
qa_gates: Phase 2 gate: 5 consecutive trading days — PO sign-off required before Phase 3
Phase 3 gate: 10 consecutive trading days + user verbal confirmation
